question: Each time Form re-renders, the text typed into the input disappears. Why?
options: Field is a new component on every render
The input needs a key prop
say: Each time Form re-renders, the text typed into the input disappears. Why?
explanation: Field is defined inside Form, so every render creates a different Field function. React sees a different component in that position and resets its state.
explainSay: Field is defined inside Form. Each render makes a brand new Field function, so React treats it as a different component and resets its state.
